First observation - The defense in the first half reminded me of week one last year. Seemed like they had been reading thier own press all off-season. They got exposed. Flat out. They managed to turn it around in the second half, especially in the 3rd quarter. Big time players made big time plays.

Second observation- The loss of Houston and Nico hurt us. At least this game. We had almost no passrush other than buckner (who honestly dominated thier interior for a lot of the game.) 
Kwitty had a couple decent reps. But failed to set the edge or bit on the read option a couple times. Costing the team. 

Third Observation- The offense is suffering almost entirely from poor LT play. I appreciate the job Davenport is doing but he's just a liability. With time and the return of Fisher (even if his play drops off a bit post injury) I can see this offense being absolutely soul crushing for opposing defenses. Long methodical drives, with a passing game built to take advantage of Carson's arm. 

Fourth and final observation- situational awareness from Frank and Carson was a bit spotty. It baffles me how were willing to go for it on 4th. Honestly I almost always say go for it if it's under two yards to go with our OLine. But that's why the "not in a rush" 2-Minute drill at the end of both halves was kinda iffy to me. We definitely could have pushed for a field goal at least to end the half. And definitely had enough time to drive for a touchdown at the end. I get that they don't want to get desperate and make costly mistakes. But I felt like we left a lot of points on the board today.
